name: Sokenzan City
description: Mountain city of artisans and artificers where the Uprisers are based.

description_citations.text: "Asari Uprisers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sokenzan artisans take pride in reusing metal.
timeline.quote: Among the artisans of Sokenzan City, reusing every scrap of metal is a point of pride.

citation.text: Sokenzan Smelter (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After the emperor disappears the Uprisers begin preparing a large-scale coup.
timeline.quote: After the emperor disappeared, the Uprisers began preparing a large-scale coup.

timeline.summary: Risona resigned as an Imperial to protest the leaderless regime and now leads the Uprisers.
timeline.quote: a former Imperial who resigned to protest the current, leaderless regime
